note: FusionStream addon catalog. The app downloads this file to show the Addon Store. 'packs' are one-click bundles; 'store' marks addons allowed in the Microsoft Store edition.

addons.name: Public Domain Movies
addons.description: Thousands of classic films that are free to watch, from Internet Archive. Built into FusionStream.

addons.name: Cinemeta
addons.description: Popular, new and top-rated movies and series with full information and artwork.

addons.name: The Movie Database
addons.description: Extra catalogs from TMDB: trending, by genre, by year and by streaming service. Multi-language.

addons.name: Anime Catalogs
addons.description: Anime catalogs from MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu and more.

addons.name: WatchHub
addons.description: Shows where to legally watch a title: Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV and more. Opens in your browser.

addons.name: OpenSubtitles
addons.description: Subtitles in many languages for movies and series.

addons.name: Torrentio
addons.description: Third-party torrent addon (not made by FusionStream). Streams from public torrent sites.

packs.name: Starter pack
packs.description: Everything you need to start: catalogs, information, subtitles and legal free movies.
